name: Ais
source:
“You look lost, little sparrow.”

Cloaked in the scent of smoke and blood, Ais is infamous in Eridia for being a violent, unpredictable outsider. His intimidating demeanor and easy confidence suggests he was once a seasoned leader, but now he’s alone—unless you count the ancient, eldritch being he formed a pact with.

With his borrowed, unnerving abilities, Ais seems capable of curing you…but a sick sense of dread surrounds him. He’s beginning to suspect that he may not be as in control of his powers as he thought. Can you save each other, or will he drag you down into the abyss with him?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/touchstarved/touchstarved?ref=f3kxoe]Kickstarter[/url]]
